An injected known change shows red before the harness grades any Rust build.
NOT SATISFIED, AND THE REASON IS A STALE BINDING RATHER THAN A MISSING RED-PROOF. Measured by vc 2026-09-09 17:47Z. The red-proof exists and is recorded: FLOORS.md says `redproof` "currently passes: the injected pixel defect goes red on exactly one slide at 0.999752, and the injected structural defect fails before any pixel number is reported". Two injections, one discriminating on a single slide and one refusing at the right stage -- exactly what this row asks for. THE PROBLEM IS THE WORD "CURRENTLY". FLOORS.md was written at 14:21 local and the harness has been committed to SIX TIMES since. Measured by reading each commit's HUNK CONTEXT rather than its diff text -- which functions the changed lines actually fall inside: cmd_redproof's call graph is capture, compare_structure, load_compiler, rmse and signature, and since 14:21 the commits touched cmd_redproof ITSELF (28b4127), capture (28b4127), compare_structure (03a44ce and 7ad5371), load_compiler (03a44ce), and shoot twice (fab0924, 186af24), which capture calls. FOUR OF FIVE CALL-GRAPH MEMBERS PLUS THE FUNCTION ITSELF. So "it currently passes" is not a slightly stale record; it is a record about a different program, and this row must not be satisfied on it. AND VC'S FIRST INSTRUMENT RETURNED THE OPPOSITE ANSWER, CLEANLY, WHICH IS THE PART WORTH KEEPING. A grep for added or removed lines matching `def cmd_redproof|def rmse|def capture|def shoot|PAYLOAD_RE|def compare_structure` returned ZERO for all six commits -- a plausible, well-formed zero that would have licensed satisfying this row on the 14:21 record. It is a TAUTOLOGY: the pattern can only fire when a DEFINITION LINE changes, and none of these commits changed a signature, so it could not have fired however much the bodies moved. The detector was named "touches redproof machinery" and measured "changes a def line of redproof machinery", and THE NAME CONCEALED THE NARROWING -- a detector whose population is a strict subset of the thing its name claims, which passes a "has it ever fired?" check because it fires happily on a commit that adds a function. DISCHARGED WHEN `redproof` is re-run against the current harness and both injections are shown red again, with the run dated after bc6c3fe.
RE-RUN 2026-09-09 18:42 LOCAL AGAINST THE HARNESS AT bc6c3fe, BOTH INJECTIONS RED, EXIT 0. Artifact 008 (daaa503ad7db), reel008 reconstruction, ctl10 floors. PIXEL: slide 6 alone at RMSE 0.999752, the other twenty graded slides at their control floors, and one not-gradeable slide EXCLUDED BY NAME -- slide 1, the unprovable brand literal -- rather than silently tolerated. STRUCTURE: 79 differences, the first being "slide COUNT differs: reference 22, new 21", and compare exits there before the pixel stage, which is the ordering property this row wants as much as the redness.
